https://github.com/leanprover/vscode-lean4/pull/776

I find myself facing a lot of "Dependencies out of date. Press Restart File" errors. So I wrote this PR to solve it. Hopefully it may help others
#Editors & UIs > Add VSCode command to restart all files / rebuild imports
As someone who often makes changes in Mathlib, it is absolutely essential for me that Lean does not "Restart File" when this means building a large chunk of mathlib.
Note that the PR only adds an option to automatically restart files. This option is off by default.
